name: MISSING
source:
A short VN style game made in Rpgmaker in which you try to find out what happened to your missing friend.

[From [url=https://c2phos.itch.io/missing]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款用RPG Maker制作的视觉小说风格短篇游戏。你要设法弄清楚，失踪的朋友究竟遭遇了什么。

[摘自[url=https://c2phos.itch.io/missing]itch.io[/url]]
